args.summary: Following the deployment of v2.3.1, checkout-api began failing health checks in production. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (us-east succeeded; us-west and eu-west remained on v2.3.1), so the rollback was retried and completed successfully. Service is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0 with error rate reduced from 18% to 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure is under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
The incident was created successfully despite the timeout response (INC-0001), so no retry was needed.

## Summary

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: Release history showed v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back**: First attempt partially failed (us-east succeeded, us-west and eu-west remained on v2.3.1 at 18% error rate). Retried the rollback, which completed in all regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), healthy, with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the health check failures, the partial-failure rollback retry, and recovery details.

No change-manager approval was required since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production — only the rollback of a known-good version, which is within standard runbook authority.
